subject: Roadmap sprint heatmap + launch playbook (QBR prep)
messages:
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Amber Li <amber@stratusai.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Roadmap sprint heatmap + launch playbook (QBR prep)

All — attaching the sprint heatmap and an initial launch playbook for the QBR prep (QBR is Nov 12). I pulled together the current sprint-level status across the product/eng workstreams and highlighted items that are likely to affect the planned GA window. Key asks:

- Read the heatmap (sprint_heatmap.png) and mark any item you believe should be treated as a "blocker" versus "watch" by EOW (Nov 6).
- Owners: call out a specific owner + a suggested mitigant and go/no-go trigger.
- If the timing changes impact commitments in the QBR pack (features that need to ship to meet the OKR), flag here — we will update the deck.

Top-level summary:
- Feature set A: on track but two integration tests failing intermittently (infra flakiness).
- Feature set B: scope creep risk; product has proposed a reduced M1 and backlog for M2.
- Model infra: quantization validation slipping by ~3 days; plan and rollback exist but needs owner.

Attachments: sprint_heatmap.png, launch_playbook_v1.xlsx

I will synthesize responses into a consolidated playbook and send a follow-up with action owners.

Thanks — Lukas
Lukas Meyer
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Nov 2026 10:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Roadmap sprint heatmap + launch playbook (QBR prep)

Lukas — quick infra readout:

- The intermittent test failures are coming from the multi-GPU sync in our nightly regression. I sketched a mitigation path (infra_mitigation_sketch.pdf) that pins GPU kernel selection for the nightly runs and adds a short backoff/retry at the request scheduler. That should reduce flakes during canary runs.
- Owner: I'll take point on the mitigation, will pair with SRE (we'll need a 3-hour maintenance window next Tuesday to validate).
- Go/no-go trigger: if nightly pass rate < 98% after mitigation, we pause canary promotion and open a rollback window.

I also added a note in the playbook about temporary traffic shaping for the first 48h post-launch to keep tail latency within SLA.

Karthik
Staff Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Roadmap sprint heatmap + launch playbook (QBR prep)

Thanks — noted. From product timelines:

- Feature set B: after scoping with PMs, we have two options — (A) reduce M1 to the critical path (recommended) with full refund-gap backlog for M2, or (B) keep scope and shift GA by 2 weeks.
- Product recommendation: option A to protect customer commitments tied to OKR. I attached a short rationale and a proposed canary-window document (canary-window-proposal.md).
- Owner: Evelyn (product) + Karthik (engineering) to finalize the reduced M1 list and update the QBR slides by Nov 8.

If we go with A, we need CS and Docs to prepare messaging; looping in Grace for readiness and support playbook updates.

Evelyn
VP, Product Management
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Nov 2026 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Roadmap sprint heatmap + launch playbook (QBR prep)

Team — good progress. A few leadership asks to close before the QBR:

1) OKR impact: call out which heatmap items directly endanger Q4 OKR "Reduce inference cost per 1M tokens by 12%" and which affect availability SLA. We need a short table mapping item -> OKR exposure.
2) Escalation policy: for any blocker that hits the go/no-go trigger, I want an explicit 3-step escalation path (owner -> exec on-call -> leadership review) with times-to-respond. Put that in the consolidated playbook.
3) Customer-facing risks: Amber (external) asked for a short note on what to expect if we trim M1 — include a one-page summary for partners/procurement.

Grace — can you confirm CS readiness for both options (A & B) and whether a staged rollout (10% -> 30% -> 100%) is acceptable from support coverage perspective?

I'll expect the consolidated playbook by Nov 9 COB.

Vivek
CTO (acting)
From: Lukas Meyer <lukas.meyer@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Amber Li <amber@stratusai.com>, procurement@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 17:03:00 -0800
Subject: Consolidated playbook and action items — next steps (final for QBR pack)

Team — thanks for the fast turn. Consolidated playbook (consolidated_playbook_v2.xlsx) is attached and I've pushed the live heatmap + decisions to the Drive link and Confluence page. Summary of decisions and owners: 

- Decision: Adopt Product option A (reduced M1) to preserve launch commitments tied to customer-facing OKRs.
  - Owner: Evelyn Hart — finalize reduced M1 list by Nov 10 12:00 PST.
- Decision: Apply Karthik's infra mitigation and schedule a 3-hour validation window on Nov 10 02:00–05:00 PST.
  - Owner: Karthik Iyer; rollback trigger defined inside sheet.
- Decision: Staged rollout (10% -> 30% -> 100%) with traffic shaping for first 48h.
  - Owner: Grace O'Connor to confirm CS playbook and staging runbook by Nov 10 16:00 PST.
- Leadership: Vivek will approve SLA exception gating language and escalation path in the playbook.

External comms: Amber / procurement were looped to give partners an advance heads-up. I drafted a 1-page partner summary in the Drive folder — feel free to edit.

Next steps: everyone to update the consolidated_playbook_v2.xlsx with final notes and the OKR exposure table by COB Nov 10. I'll fold the final playbook into the QBR packet on Nov 11 morning.

Thanks,
Lukas
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: consolidated_playbook_v2.xlsx
